question: 按自然季度计算，2024 年第三季度（7–9 月）末 HP 的总资产是多少百万美元？

tool_calls.name: run_sql
tool_calls.arguments:
{"sql": "SELECT p.company_id, p.fiscal_year, p.fiscal_quarter, p.period_end, p.calendar_quarter, p.days, f.account_code, f.value, f.version, f.source
FROM periods p
JOIN facts f ON f.company_id = p.company_id AND f.fiscal_year = p.fiscal_year AND f.fiscal_quarter = p.fiscal_quarter
WHERE p.company_id = 'HP' AND p.calendar_quarter = '2024Q3' AND f.account_code = 'total_assets' AND f.version = 'original'
ORDER BY p.period_end"}
